topic: How to Evaluate a Small Industrial or Flex Property
caption:
Small industrial and flex buildings are essential to local commerce, but their investment quality depends on practical, project-specific details. This lesson focuses on the items that most commonly affect value and operation: site access and loading, zoning and permitted uses, utility and electrical capacity, roof and structural condition, tenant responsibilities, and routine versus capital expense timing. Use a standard checklist, document conditions with photos, and prioritize repairs that protect operations. Review leases and insurance to confirm who pays for what. Need a tailored checklist, local referrals, or help modeling cash flow for a Chester or Montgomery County property? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to download tools and ask questions.
